answer_1.quote: ...We propose Chain-of-Talkers (COTALK), an AI-in-the-loop annotation framework ... annotators sequentially contribute descriptions ... to generate image captions...

answer_2.quote: ...We conduct intrinsic evaluation using semantic units ... Extrinsic evaluation: retrieval-based evaluation ... achieving an average of 41.13% across three datasets and six retrieval tasks...

answer_4.quote: ...Eight annotators answer five questions per image in both text and audio formats... We measure reading vs listening time, accuracy, and annotation speed (semantic units per second)...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered generated questions and were timed; accuracy of answers and speed were recorded.
